meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制Claude的记忆模式,让重要内容按场景自动记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望Claude按场景记住关键信息并提醒你
copy.tagline_en: Create custom memory modes so Claude tracks what matters by scenario
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Claude to remember key details per scenario and remind you

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先问你正在做什么，再提出一套观察类型和概念标签，经你确认后把这个自定义模式安装并激活，重启 worker，并验证它出现在启动上下文里。
howto.when: 当你想自定义 claude-mem 记住什么、新建或修改模式、增加观察类型或标签，或为特定记忆配置 Telegram 提醒时触发，即使你没说「模式」这个词。

say.text: 帮我建个自定义模式，记录案件规则和考点陷阱
say.note: Claude 会先访谈你，再提出类型方案待你确认

say.text: 我想在 code 模式基础上加实验结论和事故记录
say.note: 它会给出具体类型和标签让你增删改

say.text: 给这个模式的某个类型配置 Telegram 提醒
say.note: 匹配是「或」：任一选中类型或概念都会推送

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude interviews you about your work, proposes observation types and concept tags, and after your approval installs and activates the custom claude-mem mode, restarts the worker, and verifies it appears in startup context.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add observation types or tags, or set Telegram alerts for particular memories.

say_en.text: Create a custom mode that tracks case rules and exam traps
say_en.note: Claude interviews you first, then proposes the taxonomy

say_en.text: Customize my code mode to also track incidents and cost findings
say_en.note: It proposes types and tags, then asks for approval

say_en.text: Set Telegram alerts for one observation type of this mode
say_en.note: Bot setup uses hidden input, never the chat
